title: Customs fees
pageDescription: The customs fee list per model. A phone keeps the fee that was current when it was scanned in.
versionsHint: Every list you load is saved as its own version; older versions are never deleted.
linkedHint: "Yes" — this code is in use. "No" — no model is linked to this code, so its fee is not applied to any phone.
newListHint: The new list applies to phones scanned in from now on. Phones already in stock keep their fee.
emptyBody: No customs fees have been loaded. Once you add a list, phones scanned in afterwards get their fee automatically.
emptyStep2: Import the Excel file or type the rows by hand
emptyStep3: Link the codes to your models and save
emptyNoPermission: No customs list has been loaded yet. Only someone with customs management permission can add one.
unmatchedTitle: Models that won't get a fee
unmatchedEmpty: Every model has a customs code in the current list
unmatchedHelp: These models won't get a customs fee: they have no code, or their code is not in the current list.
unmatchedFixMissing: Set a customs code on the model in the Models tab
unmatchedFixNotInList: Add this code to a new list
reasonMissingCode: No customs code on the model
reasonNotInList: Code not in the current list
errorDuplicateCode: This code appears twice in the list. Remove one or change the code.
loadedFromFile: Loaded {count} rows from the Excel file
fileHint: The Excel file must have "Модель" and "Цена расстаможки" columns
badFile: Couldn't read the file. Use an Excel file with "Модель" and "Цена расстаможки" columns
fileEmpty: No rows found in the file
fileReadError: Couldn't read the file. Try another one
prefilledHint: Rows from the current list are prefilled. Edit only what changed.
guideText: Each row's code is a model name from the customs file. Link it to one of your models: when a phone is scanned in, the fee for that model is applied automatically.
chipsHint: The buttons under a row show which model that code belongs to. You can save the list without linking; that model just won't get a fee.
saveConsequence: Saving creates a new customs list and updates the code on {count} models.
saveConsequenceNone: Saving creates a new list only — no models are changed.
noPermission: You don't have permission to edit models, so linking is hidden. You can still save the list.
modelsUnavailable: Couldn't load the model list — linking is unavailable for now. You can still save the list.
loadErrorHint: Check your connection and try again.
addModelLinkAria: Link another model to the row "{code}"
linkedTitle: This model is already linked to this code
suggestLinkTitle: On save, the model's customs code will be set to this row's code
conflictLinkTitle: Current code: "{code}". On save it will be replaced with this row's code
overwriteAria: Replace the code for {model} with this one
listSavedWithLinks: Customs list saved · {count} model codes updated
linkFailed: {count} model codes were not saved — check edit permission or fix them manually
